sentences.text: This fish possessed very robust tooth plates, with the upper plate featuring a high anterior spine.
Fossils of Campbellodus have been found in perfect three-dimensional preservation within the Gogo Formation of Western Australia.
Campbellodus decipiens is classified as an extinct ptyctodontid placoderm fish, belonging to the class Placodermi.

Campbellodus decipiens was an extinct placoderm fish that lived approximately 380 million years ago during the Late Devonian period, specifically in the Frasnian stage between 382.31 and 379 million years ago.
